{"type":"thought","data":"Carefully evaluating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the Stade Brestois "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDevigged consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" puts Brest at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 42.5% and Nice at 29.3%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.565 for No implies"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw probability "}
{"type":"thought","data":"near 57.5%. FOX lines"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show Brest at +117 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and Nice at +222."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Polymarket price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 43.5% for Yes aligns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" closely with the devigged"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmaker probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggesting no meaningful"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge exists. The higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is No at 56.5%, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"that is the safer pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nHome advantage and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Brest's superior attack"}
{"type":"thought","data":" metrics (1.9 goals/game"}
{"type":"thought","data":" vs Nice 0.9) suggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" their true win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may exceed 50%. That"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would make Yes the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"more likely outcome "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to pay off."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNice's away record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is weak. They have "}
{"type":"thought","data":"lost seven consecutive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" top-flight away games"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and scored only one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal in that stretch."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Brest has won their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last two home meetings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against Nice, including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 4-1 victory in September"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2025. Betting models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" like OddAlerts, Figaro,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Football Nation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all estimate Brest "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at roughly 46% to 47%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly above the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNice is missing several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key players, including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Abdi, Bombito, Mendy,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Abergel, and Sanson."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Their depleted lineup"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may struggle to contain"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Brest's attack.\n\nBrest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has kept a clean sheet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all season. They have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won only one of their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last seven home league"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches. Sports Mole"}
{"type":"thought","data":" predicts a 1-2 Nice"}
{"type":"thought","data":" victory."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nScores24, Forebet,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Formatic all favor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw. Brest's defense"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is weakened by the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"absence of Chardonnet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Le Guen; Tousart"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is filling in at center"}
{"type":"thought","data":" back. Their 1-1 result"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against Lille was likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" inflated by xG. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5-1 victory over Angers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be an outlier. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Wind at 27 mph could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" raise variance but "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probably will not push"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Brest's win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above 50%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe most likely outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off is No. Even"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the most bullish credible"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model still estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw or Nice win "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at roughly 53%. Confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should reflect the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"estimated probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of No winning, not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"certainty about the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"analysis itself. A prior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calibration issue is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" noted: past picks of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No against favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" like Ajax, Sociedad,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Ferencvaros all"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lost."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBrest is the 1X2 favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but not the binary "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favorite because a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exists. Picking No "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is therefore the correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side for \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off.\" The prior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calibration issue involved"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fading teams that were"}
{"type":"thought","data":" actually likely to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"win outright, not a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"draw market. Now calculating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBetting No at 0.565"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly 77 profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on a 100-token stake"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if the match ends in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw or Nice win."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Betting Yes at 0.435"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offers about 130 profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but hits only 43% of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the time. Expected "}
{"type":"thought","data":"value is nearly identical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for both sides, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the higher probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome is the safer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" choice to maximize "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the chance of winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this round."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe away form is already"}
{"type":"thought","data":" baked into the Brest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 2.15–2.25,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the market has priced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in Nice’s poor record."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Other agents may still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chase the home-favorite narrative and pile into Yes. The correct strategy is to follow the base-rate probability rather than go contrarian. I will place No at roughly 0.58 confidence and check the bet syntax before submitting."}
